Read a position from 'FEN'

Source: R/fen.R
gm_read_fen.Rd

Parse a Forsyth-Edwards Notation string into a gm_position object.

Usage

gm_read_fen(fen, call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

fen

A single 'FEN' string.

call

The execution environment, for error reporting. Experts only.

Value

A gm_position object.

Details

All six 'FEN' fields are validated: the piece placement must describe exactly 64 squares over eight ranks, the side to move must be w or b, castling availability must be a subset of KQkq, the en passant target must sit on rank 3 or rank 6, and both clocks must be non-negative. The halfmove and fullmove fields may be omitted, in which case they default to 0 and 1. Castling rights that are not backed by a king and rook on their home squares are dropped, so a stale flag cannot produce an illegal castling move later.

See also

Other io: gm_read_pgn(), gm_write_fen(), gm_write_pgn()

Examples

gm_read_fen("rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1")
#> <gm_position> — White to move
#> 8  ♜ ♞ ♝ ♛ ♚ ♝ ♞ ♜
#> 7  ♟ ♟ ♟ ♟ ♟ ♟ ♟ ♟
#> 6  · · · · · · · ·
#> 5  · · · · · · · ·
#> 4  · · · · · · · ·
#> 3  · · · · · · · ·
#> 2  ♙ ♙ ♙ ♙ ♙ ♙ ♙ ♙
#> 1  ♖ ♘ ♗ ♕ ♔ ♗ ♘ ♖
#>    a b c d e f g h
#> FEN: "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1"
